name: Chaotic realistic day
description: A full working day: two repositories, three real pieces of work fragmented into six blocks, a PR review, an hour of lunch, Slack, email, personal browsing and a CI failure at the end of the day.
tests: The primary benchmark. Separating three contexts is the easy half; the hard half is reassembling each one from blocks separated by hours and by other work — the checkout bug spans 09:02 to 16:34 in three blocks, and onboarding spans two blocks either side of lunch. An engine that only groups contiguous activity fragments this day into six or more contexts. An engine that groups on temporal proximity alone merges the noise into whatever it sits between.
